projectDescription: A MERN stack platform that tracks students' Codeforces competitive programming progress with automated daily sync, inactivity email alerts, rating analytics, and personalized dashboards.
keyFeatures: Student CRUD management with Codeforces handle tracking
Automated daily Codeforces data sync via scheduled cron jobs
Manual per-student and bulk sync from the dashboard UI
Submission heatmap visualization for activity tracking
Rating history chart and contest performance breakdown
Problems-by-difficulty bar chart with rating bucket distribution
Topic/tag breakdown analytics with solved counts and average ratings
Consistency score, learning velocity, and predicted rating metrics
Inactivity detection with automated email reminders via Nodemailer/Brevo
Redis caching layer (Upstash) for Codeforces API responses
Sortable, searchable student table with real-time summary stats
publicApiSurface: POST /api/students — create student (triggers immediate CF sync)
GET /api/codeforces/sync/:handle — trigger manual sync for a handle
GET /api/codeforces/stats/:handle?days= — get submission stats for a handle
GET /api/codeforces/contest/:handle?days= — get contest history for a handle
POST /cron/sync — externally-triggered full sync (requires x-cron-secret header)
POST /cron/sync-all — manual full sync from UI
GET /api/inactivity/logs — get inactivity log for all students
POST /api/inactivity/disable/:id — disable email reminders for a student
POST /api/inactivity/enable/:id — enable email reminders for a student
